business_problem: Home-services contractors can waste digital ad spend when static campaigns send leads to fully booked businesses, while cancellations leave scheduling gaps. CAMP Digital needed a foundation that could ingest operational data, evaluate business patterns, and make campaign adjustments at scale without manual delay.
solution_summary: CAMP Digital connects home-services operational data—including job patterns, live technician availability, customer databases, and ad spend—with campaign workflows that otherwise rely on static budgets and manual changes. BigQuery stores and processes structured historical and customer data; key operational signals refresh every 15 minutes so agents can query current capacity and spend. Gemini, specifically the page's cited Gemini 3.6 Flash model, supports agent-to-agent workflows for text summarization, sentiment analysis, and data enrichment. Agents assess schedules, weather-driven service demand, and seasonality, then adjust ad spend, geographic service areas, and promotions—or scale spend back when calendars fill. A specialized workflow agent analyzes customer service calls for missed booking opportunities. The platform also provides plain-language recommendations for human oversight. Cloud Run is named as part of the solution foundation, though the page does not specify its role.

evidence_quotes: Static ad spend may drive traffic to a fully booked business or leave scheduling gaps from last minute cancellations.

The team stores and processes structured historical data as well as customer data such as job patterns, live contractor availability, and customer databases in BigQuery that its AI can search in seconds.
Many of these vital data points are also automatically refreshed every fifteen minutes to ensure information such as customers’ ad spend is up-to-date for agents.
This structured data feeds into Gemini and its models, specifically Gemini 3.6 Flash, to orchestrate agent-to-agent workflows, including text summarization, sentiment analysis, and data enrichment.
The company was also able to develop and launch the agentic platform using less than 3% of its annual revenue.

These expanded agentic solutions have also allowed the team to support new business without having to hire additional headcount. By automating repetitive manual work, the team shifted an entire division into more strategic roles with zero layoffs.
